observation.visible_scene: A lit, pale cream taper candle stands slightly tilted in a shallow white oval dish resting on a wooden surface, set against a vertical wood-paneled wall. The candle has a short curled black wick and a single steady flame that leans to the right, casting an orange glow on the panel behind it.
visible_changes: The flame flickers throughout the excerpt, cycling between tall, narrow, pointed shapes and shorter, broader, rounded shapes, with its tip shifting position frame to frame.
The orange glow on the wood panel behind the flame brightens, dims, and drifts slightly in sync with the flame's flickering.
The candle body, wick, dish, and wood background remain essentially fixed in position; the camera is largely stationary, showing at most minor handheld jitter.
No measurable shortening or deformation of the candle wax is visible over this segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the candle had just been lit or was already burning before the crop, and whether it is extinguished or melts further after the segment ends.
The source of any air movement influencing the flame's lean and flicker.
uncertain_details: Whether small apparent shifts at the frame edges are camera jitter or genuine scene motion.
The exact rate of wax consumption, which is too small to confirm within this window.
